approved_scope.title: Rebase a stale MODIFIED requirement delta automatically when main's edit does not overlap it, keeping the approval
approved_scope.description: Rebase a stale MODIFIED requirement delta automatically when main's edit does not overlap it, keeping the approval
acceptance_criteria: When main edits a requirement a MODIFIED delta was approved against and the two edits do not overlap word by word, change check rewrites the delta to the merge, records a verifiable rebase in approvals.json, keeps the approval and materializes the merged text; when they overlap it refuses as today and asks for re-approval; change status shows each rebase

answers.constraints: CHANGE-6.a (an approval is bound to what it approved, so the rebase must be a recorded, re-checkable merge, not a silent edit), CHANGE-6.c, the #843 stale MODIFIED refusal (REQ-change-122) and the #975 moved-base recovery from git
